title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Work with the frontend team to build responsive web interfaces and improve user experience across products.

title: Python Developer Intern
description: Build backend services, automate repetitive tasks, and support API development for internal business tools.
eligibility: Any graduate in CS/IT with Python fundamentals

title: Data Science Intern
description: Analyze datasets, translate business questions into data products, and support model evaluation for growth strategy.
eligibility: Students pursuing statistics, data science or computer science

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Help build predictive models, experiment with ML pipelines, and validate model performance with real-world data.
eligibility: B.Tech or M.Tech students in AI/ML or related fields

title: AI Research Intern
description: Explore AI research ideas, build prototypes, and contribute to experiments on language and decision systems.
eligibility: Students with strong programming and research interest

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Create user-centered interface designs, support prototyping activities, and refine product experience flows.
eligibility: Design students or graduates with portfolio experience

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: Assist with security assessments, vulnerability analysis, and documentation of defensive controls for client systems.
eligibility: Computer science or information security students

title: Cloud Engineering Intern
description: Support cloud infrastructure projects, automation scripts, and deployment workflows for scalable applications.
eligibility: Students with basic cloud or DevOps concepts

title: Android App Developer Intern
description: Work on Android app features, UI implementation, and debugging improvements for customer-facing mobile experiences.
eligibility: B.Tech or BCA students with Android development interest

title: Software Development Intern
description: Develop full-stack features, collaborate with senior engineers, and participate in code reviews for enterprise systems.

title: QA Automation Intern
description: Create automated tests, document defects, and support quality assurance workflows across application releases.
eligibility: Students with interest in test automation and software quality

title: Business Analyst Intern
description: Translate business requirements into data-driven insights, prepare reports, and support analytic dashboards.
eligibility: Students from commerce, statistics or analytics backgrounds

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: Build and maintain full-stack web features, contribute to API integration, and improve application performance.
eligibility: Students familiar with JavaScript and web application development

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Prepare business reports, validate data quality, and create dashboards that communicate trend insights clearly.
eligibility: Students in analytics, economics or computer science

title: DevOps Intern
description: Support deployment automation, monitor application health, and contribute to troubleshooting in cloud environments.
